test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 169 is related to 11 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 625 is related to 23. To which of the following is 961 related to, following the same logic?
solution:
Logic: [First no.] : [(First no + 2)²]

 
• 
 
For 169:

 
 
• 
 
(11+2)²=13²=169

 
 
 
 
• 
 
For 625:

 
 
• 
 
(23+2)²=25²=625

 
 
 

Applying the logic to 961:

 
• 
 
Let the number be x such that 

 
 
• 
 
(x+2)²=961

 
 
• 
 
x+2=√961

 
 
• 
 
x+2=31

 
 
• 
 
x=31−2

 
 
• 
 
x=29

 

Thus, according to the given logic, 961 is related to 29.
